## talk

**Version:** 0.2

**Purpose:** The one conversation the user has. Drives the screen through the Cue protocol, owns the observer and planner as delegates, dispatches builder and reviewer, and is the clarification path.

**Tier:** mid
 → openrouter/anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6


**Tools:** say, ask, navigate, point, clear, sequence, stage, glossary, answer, followup, commit, discard, undo, read_graph, read_open, raise_question, revalidate, dispatch_task, run_review

**Sandbox:** none

**Runs in:** local-node

**Budget:** 200 turns, 3600000 ms wall, $5 max cost
